items.title: T1 (high) wait(until)/watch/person notices used room-mode visibility; identity oracle by id in the dark
items.detail: timeline.observed/perceivable/holds_perceived now judge each atom per referenced id: entity_seen (room camera: visible, not a dark shape, realistic not missed; geometric: camera.entity_view_now, a signature-memoized acuity with 0 mismatches in 4,331 checks), agent_seen (realistic: lit room; geometric: identified in view). all/any/not are three-valued. items.title: T3 (medium) 'X leaves' never fired, 'X comes in' refused
items.detail: A people/pets location compared (eq/ne) with the robot's room is accepted while the robot watches its room, and absence is observed when the robot can tell. Deviation (documented): in geometric mode absence is observable only for tracked people (a pre-wait coverage cannot tell who walked out behind the camera); footsteps are not used because they don't identify who. Test: test_until_and_watch_on_someone_coming_in_or_leaving (oracle, realistic, dark-room refusal); probe5 now fires at 60 s.

items.title: T4 (medium) milestones/responses reached by an action stamped at its start
items.detail: Monitor.sample(env, point, at=None): the engine passes the action's end (start + seconds; a wait keeps its start; partial-commit path; auto command end). Milestones, counted times, held_for starts, response triggers and met times use the stamp; windows and never/always latches keep the sample time. Tests: updated pin test_the_action_sample_sees_what_the_action_did, new test_an_action_that_ends_after_a_deadline_misses_it. probe4: the 20 s walk now misses the 5 s deadline. Gate: 0 verdict changes.

items.title: T5 (medium) decided 'fail' from a superseded (unscored) phase
items.detail: Monitor.decided(state, skip=()) ignores the entries of phases that evaluation.decided finds ended unscored. Test: test_phases.StageCFixTests.test_a_superseded_phases_failures_do_not_decide_the_episode (fails with the fix undone).

items.title: T6 (medium) gen-2 clock showed DST while domains run on standard time
items.detail: DST now needs clock.dst: true besides model 2 (clock.dst_enabled; wall, describe, parse_when). The generator doesn't set the flag, so gen-2 houses show the time the people, clock displays and collection days keep. Moving those domains to wall time and setting the flag is a handoff follow-up. Tests: test_clock.DstFlagTests (a gen-2 house in October: obs.time hour = people's hour); DST tests set the flag.

items.title: T7 (medium) hidden weather bookkeeping readable through until/watch
items.detail: weather.<field> rejects perception.WEATHER_HIDDEN and '_' keys. With the network every perceived field is allowed. From outdoors or through a window without the network, realistic perception allows only the condition word without numeric ops. Test: test_the_weather_bookkeeping_is_not_observable (fails with the fix undone). Remaining gap noted: realistic obs.weather itself still shows numbers through a window (weather/realism follow-up).

items.title: T8 (medium) a phase's deadline met by an earlier phase's milestone
items.detail: A phase's milestones compile as '<id>/<name>' and are sampled only inside the phase. Its deadlines, triggers and anchors name them first. Monitor.overlay(phase) gives the phase's predicates their plain names, and the same name may serve several phases. Test: test_a_phases_deadline_needs_its_own_milestone.

items.title: T9 (medium) auto orders stalled inside waits; budget disabled them for multi-day waits; note uncapped
items.detail: An order due when a listening wait ends runs before the wait ends. The budget is per step and simulated hour, logged once per window; a paused firing resumes at its next command (key 'resume'), where it used to restart its commands. The orders note is capped at 10 entries with '(+N more)'. Tests: test_an_order_that_fires_in_a_listening_wait_runs_before_it_ends, test_the_command_budget_is_per_hour_of_a_long_wait, test_the_standing_orders_note_is_capped.

items.title: T10 (medium) idle verification stopped after 30 h
items.detail: verify._wait_out uses at most 30 waits of max(3600, ceil(budget/30)) s (capped at a week), applied to the episode and each phase; budgets up to 30 h are unchanged. Test: test_idle_verification_waits_out_a_long_budget (40 h; fails with the fix undone). Gate consequence: A-d66994a566899c-01 has a 64 h budget (the reviewer's scan missed it). Its idle check now reaches 230,400 s instead of 108,000 s and still fails (damage), so the verdict is unchanged, but idle_state_hash changed on 5 seeds. The gate policy has no state class for these packages; listed as a reviewed difference for the main session.

items.title: T11 (low) a contingent phase that never starts made the episode unwinnable
items.detail: New phase key 'optional': true, lint-allowed only with a when/at_s start. If not started it is unscored and does not keep the harness waiting. Other scored phases not started add 'phase_not_started:<id>' to the episode failures. Test: test_an_optional_interruption_that_never_comes_is_unscored.

items.title: P1 (high) asking about 'request' handed over the hidden target
items.detail: 'request' stays a request subject (id = the request record id, key q:<aspect>:request:<rid>). Facts and routes match the bound target internally (bound_subject/request_target). The answer's about is 'request' and 'it' stays the request. (which, request) reaches which:<category or target type>, and entity routes no longer see the target. Tests: 3 in test_dialogue.StageCFixTests; probes p10/p10b re-run clean.

items.title: P2 (high) phone/text/app could not reach anyone away from home
items.detail: dialogue.reach and reports.deliver need only network and a phone, wherever the person is (a call refused for a deaf person; asks still need them awake). skills.ask/tell never walk to an absent person. Tests: test_phone_and_text_reach_someone_away_from_home, test_reports test_phone_text_and_app_reach_someone_away_from_home (both modes).

items.title: P3 (high) prior beliefs showed an unresolved look-alike's true type
items.detail: setup._belief records the prior level (oracle label: label, else type in words). Mind.from_config renders ident/label_seen via realism._identify at that level. Test: test_prior_look_alikes_are_remembered_at_the_level_they_were_seen. The extended perception audit flags 130 recall leaks when the old behaviour is re-injected, and 0 after the fix.

items.title: P4 (high) in the dark a typed person id came back as its shape handle
items.detail: realism.inbound: while shapes share the robot's dark room, every person/pet id is refused in every parameter (about, subject, options, to, predicate paths) with one wording for present and absent people. Ids in free text become 'someone'. Test: test_a_typed_person_id_never_comes_back_as_a_shape_in_the_dark; p14 re-run clean.

items.title: P5 (medium) privacy mode / a dark room blocked contacting anyone by id
items.detail: Commands on a remote channel (phone/text/app) name people as they are, and their reply keeps them plain (realism._named_plain). Design note: voice in the dark still refuses every id alike, because refusing only those present would itself be a who-is-here oracle. Test: test_privacy_mode_still_reaches_people_elsewhere_by_phone; p18 re-run clean.

items.title: P6 (medium) 'I'm not sure.' vs 'I don't know.' revealed modelled questions
items.detail: One default, 'I don't know.'; author-written 'otherwise' texts are kept. Test: test_someone_who_does_not_know_answers_like_an_unmodelled_question.

items.title: P7 (medium) clarify-back only when a fact existed
items.detail: For entity-directed aspects, a word naming several household things is asked back whether or not any of them has a fact, unless a fact about the word itself answers. DIALOGUE.md amended; the sweep 4.3 wording is a main-session follow-up. Test: test_a_word_naming_several_things_is_asked_back_whether_or_not_one_has_a_fact; p16 re-run clean.

items.title: P8 (medium) word subjects matched any word of compound names
items.detail: Head-noun rule in names_entity and type-fact matching ('dryer' names a clothes dryer, not dryer sheets; 'bed' a bed, not a bed pillow; modifiers must be the thing's words). Test: test_words_name_things_by_their_head_noun (fails with the fix undone).

items.title: P9 (medium) options did not resolve a clarify-back
items.detail: Options narrow what a word names: with one left the question is about it (options consumed); with several the person asks back among those. Per-option answers are not modelled (documented). Docs updated. Test: test_options_narrow_a_word_naming_several_things.

items.title: P10 (medium) memory-key substring made necessary questions unnecessary
items.detail: Memory keys must name the fact id or canonical key as whole ':'/'.' segments. Test: test_only_a_whole_memory_key_segment_names_a_fact (fails with the fix undone); p13 re-run clean. The sweep 4.5 wording is a main-session follow-up.

items.title: P11 (medium) 'who is at the door' answered from the visitor's hidden identity before the robot looked
items.detail: PEOPLE-IO's part: dialogue.VETTED_ROUTES lets people.visitor answer only about a visitor the robot has perceived (Mind). Test: test_who_is_at_the_door_needs_a_visitor_the_robot_has_seen; p2 now answers 'I don't know.' with no admit approval. Follow-up for the people domain: the visitor: answerer should use the expected list, not _identity.

items.title: P12 (medium) questions answered through a failed speaker / call to a deaf person
items.detail: Canonical voice/phone asks need body.can_speak; otherwise said '(no answer)', time spent, nothing counted, and the fault detected as speech detects it. Calls to a deaf person are refused. The legacy topic path is left byte-identical (gate rule; follow-up). Tests: test_a_question_through_a_failed_speaker_gets_no_answer, the deaf case in the away-phone test.

items.title: P13 (medium) obs.request misattributed relays and leaked a remote sender's room
items.detail: request_view: a relayed request's from is the relayer and claims_from the claimed requester (dialogue.requester unchanged). Room is shown only for in-person/overheard/intercom. The runner and post_request default the room to the speaker's, and the request message's room is None for remote channels. Tests: test_a_relayed_request_is_said_by_its_relayer, test_a_remote_request_does_not_say_where_its_sender_is.

items.title: P14 (medium) listen dropped alarm notices in privacy mode
items.detail: listen returns the stored (already perceived) notices as they are. Test: test_listen_returns_every_perceived_notice_in_privacy_mode; p7 re-run clean.

items.title: P15 (medium, TIME-EVAL) privacy mode dropped non-speech sound notices
items.detail: robot_perceives under 'addressed' hearing now drops only speech not addressed to the robot. Test: AudibilityTests updated pin (knock and glass_breaking heard, third-party speech not).

items.title: P16 (low) request message speaker named the sender realism anonymised
items.detail: Realistic obs.messages: a request's own message names its speaker with the same decision as obs.request (realism.request_sender). Test: test_the_request_message_names_its_sender_as_the_request_does; p6 re-run clean.

items.title: P17 (low) a note-channel request could not name its note via a spec
items.detail: 'note' added to spec.REQUEST_KEYS (lint: note channel only) and copied by post_request. Test: test_a_note_request_names_its_note_through_a_spec (runner level, both modes).

items.title: P18 (low) a request's gesture was not in the first observation
items.detail: post_request fires people's people.point effect immediately. Test: test_a_requests_gesture_is_in_the_first_observation (both modes); p15 shows the gesture at t=0.

items.title: P19 (low) answers exposed the legacy route topic
items.detail: route/topic are kept in dialogue_log only. RouteTests pins updated to assert no 'route' in answers; the audit flags any answer carrying route.

items.title: P20 (low) realistic clarify options name look-alikes by true labels; handoff claimed otherwise
items.detail: Decision: options are the person's own words for their things (household knowledge) and never map to handles, so they don't reveal which handle is which. DIALOGUE.md documents it and the PEOPLE-IO handoff's known-gap bullet is corrected.

items.title: P21 (low) agent docs inaccurate or cut sentences
items.detail: DIALOGUE.md (options, look-alike memory, channels, request subject), the LLM prompt (count scope optional, channels reach people away, options), ASK_DOC (default channel), and the listen doc (107 chars, whole in the 120-char catalog) corrected.

items.title: P22 (low) perception audit could not see these leaks
items.detail: tools/perception_audit.py: enrich() gives houses a request with a hidden target, prior look-alikes at a glance, and dark rooms with people. The walk asks about 'request' and about people present or not, reports to people who are away, and issues wait(until) on handles in or out of view, dark shapes and people. New checks in check_people_message and check_typed_people. Re-injecting old P1/P3 behaviour yields 2 dialogue and 130 memory leaks; the fixed tree gives 0 (G4 room and geometric).

fix.notes:
All 33 findings are fixed (11 time, 22 people), each with a regression test. The only exception is P20, a documented decision plus a docs correction. Every reviewer probe was re-run and its symptom is gone. Six fixes (P8, P10, T5, T6, T7, T10) were spot-checked: their tests fail with the old function monkeypatched back in (scratch mutation_check.py). The stage-C test files went from 233 to 274 tests, all green normal and strict.

Gate results:
- Own mode is 241/242. The one failure is A-d9e7a4d5d112d2-01 seed 0, unchanged since TIME-EVAL's reviewed S-R1 row; its spec fix is TIME-EVAL request 1 in tasks/authored, outside these packages.
- 0 verdict changes against C-MERGE in both modes.
- The single failing test (counted once; it fails in both normal and strict runs) is the pre-existing test_eval_splits.py gitignore check.

Deviations, all recorded in handoff section 11:
- Geometric 'X leaves' is observable only for tracked people (T3).
- The frozen Subject contract changed for request subjects: id is now the request record id (P1).
- In a dark room, voice commands still refuse every typed id alike; remote channels name people plainly (P5).

Performance:
- The until check costs 0.0181 ms in the gate (budget 0.02).
- The geometric-camera until costs 0.027-0.029 ms per quiet substep thanks to the new camera.entity_view_now memo (0.35-0.46 ms before it).

Follow-ups for the main session are in both handoffs:
- domains move to wall time, then set clock.dst
- the people visitor: answerer should use the expected list
- design-doc wording for sweep 4.3, 4.5, 9 and 10.2
- the legacy ask path still answers through a failed speaker
- realistic obs.weather still shows numbers through a window
